query: What is the maximum domestic flight reimbursement allowed under policy?
expected_answer: Domestic flights are reimbursed up to economy class limit of $500 without VP approval.
ground_truth_context: Corporate Travel Policy Section 4.1: Domestic flights are reimbursed up to economy class limit of $500. Any higher fare requires VP approval.

query: What is the procedure for reporting a security incident or lost laptop?
expected_answer: Report lost hardware to the SOC helpdesk within 1 hour and initiate remote wipe through IT portal.
ground_truth_context: InfoSec SOP 12: Lost laptops or mobile devices must be reported to the SOC helpdesk within 1 hour. An automated remote wipe will be initiated immediately.

query: What are the allowed authentication mechanisms for internal microservices?
expected_answer: Internal microservices must use mTLS with SPIFFE/SPIRE x509 certificates and JWT bearer tokens.
ground_truth_context: Architecture Governance Guideline 8: All East-West microservice traffic must be secured via mTLS using SPIFFE/SPIRE x509 certificates alongside signed JWT tokens.

query: What is the data retention requirement for customer financial audit logs?
expected_answer: Customer financial audit logs must be retained for 7 years in write-once-read-many storage.
ground_truth_context: Compliance Policy FIN-901: All transaction ledgers and customer audit records must be preserved for exactly 7 years in immutable WORM storage.

query: How many days of paid parental leave are employees entitled to?
expected_answer: Eligible full-time employees receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.
ground_truth_context: Employee Handbook Benefits 2026: Full-time employees with at least 6 months of tenure are entitled to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave.
